title: Transcriptomic Profiling and Bioinformatic Analysis of Bone Marrow Samples to Identify Chemotherapy Resistance Signatures in Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
snippet: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a highly heterogeneous hematologic malignancy in which relapse and acquired chemoresistance remain major causes of treatment failure.
